chapters.reason: The paper explicitly focuses on distilling a Transformer (Llama-3) into a recurrent architecture (Mamba), which is the core definition of architectural distillation and linearization.
The paper utilizes the Mamba architecture, which is a state-space model providing subquadratic complexity compared to standard Transformer attention mechanisms.
The paper emphasizes practical deployment on resource-constrained devices (smartphones/edge platforms), focusing on the application layer of efficient model deployment.
